title: Twenty Years and One Unsent Letter
subtitle: 家庭与亲情 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭与亲情（生活与学习·家庭与亲情）
meta: 主题语境：家庭与亲情（生活与学习·家庭与亲情）　|　核心词汇：daughter　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 daughter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my grandmother ① raised a daughter that no neighbour in the lane would have understood, and she said the raising was the whole of the household. The ② daughter, meaning the child and not the heiress, ran twenty years and stayed unmentioned in the will; a daughter, she said, is the only thing in a family that is judged by how long she is left unnamed.

Every ③ daughter in that lane had the same unsent letter against her, and the ④ daughter at the end, meaning the one who came back on Sundays and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A daughter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to listen; my grandmother said the listening is the part that fills twenty years.

The lawyer meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the daughter was the whole of the estate, meaning the heiress and not the child. The ⑥ daughter, meaning the heiress and not any of that, is the only thing in an estate that everybody names and nobody asks; daughter, he said, is either somebody you raise or the only word that means both a child and an heiress. He said the heiress is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ daughter had become a line in a deed, and the deed had become an argument about the unsent letter. The ⑧ daughter of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in February, was one household and twenty years of listening; daughter, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to listen. She said the listening was never mentioned.

The ⑨ daughter I remember is the one at the end, who last wrote in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ daughter, my mother said in 1983, is the only one who improves by being listened to; every daughter, she said, is an heiress who has agreed to look like a child. She said the heiress was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 女儿（指家里养大的那一个孩子）
B. n. 女儿（指那个孩子本身，与那个继承人相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise a daughter 抚养一个女儿
D. n. 女儿（指周日回来的那一个）
E. n. 女儿；闺女（抽象总称，指一家人里的女儿身份）
F. n. 女儿（指契据上写到、被列名的那一个）
G. n. 女儿（指遗产继承中的那个女继承人）
H. n. 继承人（抽象总称，指人人列名却无人去问的那一位）

items.q: raised a daughter that no neighbour in the lane would have understood
The daughter, meaning the child and not the heiress
the daughter was the whole of the estate
the daughter had become a line in a deed
The daughter of the whole thing
A daughter, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: raise a daughter 意为“抚养一个女儿”，1956 年祖母抚养了一个巷子里没有一位邻居能理解的女儿。
daughter 意为“女儿”，指那个孩子本身而不是那个继承人，她在遗嘱里二十年没有被提到。
daughter 意为“女儿”，指那条巷子里每一个女儿，每一个都有一封没有寄出的信对着她们。
daughter 意为“女儿”，指周日回来的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
daughter 意为“女儿”，指遗产继承中的那个女继承人，律师说这个继承人就是那份遗产的全部。
daughter 意为“继承人”，指人人列名却无人去问的那一位而不是那个孩子，是遗产里人人都列名、却无人去问的人。
daughter 意为“女儿”，指契据上写到、被列名的那一个，到 1965 年这个女儿成了契据里的一行。
daughter 意为“女儿、闺女”，祖母二月写道，整件事的女儿身份是一户人家和二十年的倾听。
daughter 意为“女儿”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1981 年最后一次写信，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的。
daughter 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，一个女儿是唯一会因为被倾听而变得更好的人。
